title.narrative: Accelerating Malaria Control Towards Elimination by 2030 - Philippines (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Philippines, Malaria, Pilipinas Shell Foundation, Inc. (PSFI Philippines)This program has the following goals: All 82 provinces of the country declared malaria-free by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Reduce malaria in Palawan to zero by 2026. Declare 81 provinces malaria-free by 2027. Sustain malaria-free status; prevent re-establishment of malaria transmission in 82 provinces
